name: Mas Auto Repair
hook: Your customers on Buckeystown Pike walk in without an appointment and drive out with a fixed car — or a new-to-them one from your lot. They could be sending you the job from their phone the night before. Take a look:
fakt: you've been running Mas as a family-owned shop since 2022, you take cars without an appointment Monday to Saturday, you do full scanner diagnostics and engine and transmission work, and you sell cars from the same lot
na_stronie: your name and phone, your seven services in your words — brakes, oil & filter change, mount & balance tires, caliper, full scanner diagnostics, engine & transmission, cars for sale — your opening days from 8 AM, online booking and a contact form straight to your inbox
dlaczego: A walk-in shop lives on being found first: a page with your services, your lot and a booking button turns the search into a visit before they drive on. Every request lands in your email — no voicemail.
